n: A pilgrim’s love song for the temple, by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwelling places, Lord of armies!

f.g: Dwelling places — the temple and its courts.

n: The psalmist longs so much for God’s courts that he feels faint; his whole being cries out for the living God. Many Latter-day Saints feel this same longing for the temple.

f.w: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth

f.g: The open courtyards of the temple where worshippers gathered.

n: He envies even the little birds that nest near God’s altars. If a sparrow can find a home in God’s house, surely there is room for him.

f.w: the sparrow hath found an house

n: How happy are those who live in God’s house — the priests and Levites — always praising him.

f.w: they will be still praising thee
f.g: They will always be praising you.

n: Blessed is the one who finds strength in God and whose heart is set on the pilgrim roads to Zion.

f.g: The highways — the pilgrim roads to Jerusalem.

n: As pilgrims pass through a dry “valley of weeping,” they turn it into a place of springs, and autumn rains fill it with pools. Faith can turn hard places into blessings.

f.g: Possibly “valley of balsam trees” or “valley of weeping” — a dry stretch on the journey.

n: Rather than growing weary, the pilgrims grow stronger the closer they get, until each one appears before God in Zion.

f.w: They go from strength to strength

n: A prayer from the temple: Lord God of armies, God of Jacob, hear me.
He prays for the king, God’s anointed, calling God “our shield.”
One day in God’s courts is better than a thousand anywhere else. He would rather stand at the threshold of God’s house than live comfortably among the wicked.

f.w: a day in thy courts is better than a thousand

f.g: One who stands at the threshold — a humble position. The Korahites served as temple gatekeepers.

n: God is both sun and shield — light and protection. He gives grace and honor and withholds nothing good from those who live with integrity.

f.w: no good thing will he withhold

n: The final beatitude: happy is the one who trusts in you, Lord of armies.

f.w: blessed is the man that trusteth in thee
